$comment: Fixtures for tools/feature-code.js, with declared storage ["items"]. Every valid snippet must produce no problem; every invalid one must produce a problem containing 'expect'. See contracts/README.md: dynamic storage keys are not supported.

valid.literal declared key: get:
async function f(ctx){ return ctx.store.get("items"); }
return { render(){return ""} };
valid.literal declared key: set:
async function f(ctx){ await ctx.store.set("items", [1,2]); }
return { render(){return ""} };
valid.literal declared key: remove:
async function f(ctx){ await ctx.store.remove("items"); }
return { render(){return ""} };
valid.the context parameter may have any name:
function wire(c, el){ c.store.get("items").then(v => { el.textContent = String(v); }); }
return { render(){return ""}, wire };
valid.single quotes and chaining:
async function f(ctx){ const v = await ctx.store.get('items'); ctx.store.set('items', (v || []).concat([1])); }
return { render(){return ''} };
valid.a property called store on something els:
function f(){ const shop = { name: "x" }; return shop.name; }
return { render(){return ""} };
valid.other ctx members are unrestricted:
function wire(ctx, el){ ctx.toast("hi"); el.innerHTML = ctx.esc("<b>"); ctx.rerender; return ctx.profile + ctx.uid + ctx.version; }
return { render(){return ""}, wire };
